name: Santarém

queries.query: Santarém Pará Brazil official cadastral map parcel GIS cadastro imobiliário prefeitura geoserver
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official Santarém municipal portal, its public services portal, municipal transparency material, and an official municipal tax/urban-services lead. The results evidenced municipal cadastral and geoprocessing responsibilities but did not identify an open anonymous parcel feature service.

queries.query: Santarém PA cadastro territorial mapa lotes geoprocessamento prefeitura oficial
queries.result: Portuguese first-party discovery confirmed the Prefeitura de Santarém municipal cadastral custodian through the Secretaria Municipal de Finanças / Divisão and Núcleo de Cadastro Imobiliário, and land-regularization/geoprocessing responsibility through SEHAB. Official pages and documents describe cadastral, IPTU, lot/quadra geoprocessing, and digital service procedures, but no safe anonymous parcel ID plus geometry response was exposed.

officialLeads.operator: Prefeitura de Santarém, Secretaria Municipal de Finanças / Divisão and Núcleo de Cadastro Imobiliário
officialLeads.scope: Local municipal cadastral and property-tax custodian; official search results identify cadastral administration, cartographic survey, and cadastral updates.
officialLeads.evidence: The official municipal search page lists the Divisão/Núcleo de Cadastro Imobiliário, cadastral updates for IPTU, and current appointments. This is local custodian evidence, not proof of an open parcel API.

officialLeads.operator: Prefeitura de Santarém, Secretaria Municipal de Habitação e Regularização Fundiária (SEHAB)
officialLeads.scope: Local land-regularization, geoprocessing, and cadastral/topographic update responsibility.
officialLeads.evidence: Official municipal organizational material identifies SEHAB geoprocessing and topographic functions for updating municipal cadastres; it does not expose parcel geometry or a public parcel endpoint.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Official municipal portal denied this direct anonymous request. The first-party search result and linked service pages were still inspected through public search/open results; no login, CAPTCHA, or bypass was attempted.

Official public services portal loaded. HTML exposed IPTU, SEFIN, SEHAB, urbanism, and related service navigation, but no parcel viewer, vector service, layer schema, CRS, or anonymous parcel geometry endpoint.

Inspected public HTML and discovered the portal search API https://santarem.pa.gov.br/api/v2/search and links to the municipal SIAP IPTU service, Santarém Digital, and Città environmental portal. No parcel feature route was exposed; no search form was submitted.
Official municipal finance/service portal loaded. HTML described IPTU, ISS, ITBI and related tax services; no public parcel geometry or safe parcel identity endpoint was exposed.
Anonymous IPTU route returned an application error before a parcel response. No form submission, credential use, or unsafe field request occurred; this is not evidence of cadastral absence.
Legacy linked IPTU route was not available at this path; no parcel response.

Official municipal-linked Città portal loaded. Public JavaScript bootstrap/configuration was inspected; it is an environmental/licensing portal and did not expose a safe cadastral parcel layer or bounded ID+geometry response.
Official Santarém Digital link denied direct anonymous access. No login, CAPTCHA, private token, or bypass was attempted; this is not evidence of cadastral absence.
Official transparency portal loaded. It provided municipal documents and organizational evidence, but no open parcel geometry endpoint.
